Container.Name: autoscan
Container.Overview: Autoscan receives file change events from Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Readarr, and other sources. It then asks Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin to scan only the folders that changed, instead of the full library.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: sonarr radarr lidarr readarr plex emby jellyfin scan webhook arr
Container.Requires: Create config.yml in the Config folder. Until this file exists and has content, Autoscan waits and does not start. The README has an example configuration.
Container.Description:
Autoscan receives file change events from Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Readarr, and other sources. It then asks Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin to scan only the folders that changed, instead of the full library.
Create /mnt/user/appdata/autoscan/config.yml. Until this file exists and has content, Autoscan waits and checks for it every 5 seconds. Then it starts. Start from the full example in the README: https://github.com/l3uddz/autoscan#full-config-file
Configure at least one target, such as Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin. If no target exists, Autoscan accepts webhooks but does not process scans. Change the example paths, such as /mnt/unionfs/Media/, to /media paths.
The container runs as user 99 and group 100 (nobody:users). Make sure that this user can read and write the Config folder. To use a different user, change --user in Extra Parameters.
Autoscan has no web interface. Point the Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, or Readarr webhook at http://<UNRAID_IP>:3030/triggers/<trigger_name>. Set authentication in config.yml.
The paths in config.yml are the paths inside this container. If Sonarr, Plex, or another container sees a different path for the same files, add rewrite rules in config.yml.

Config.Name: Webhook port
Config.Description: Port for the trigger webhooks. Keep the container port the same as port in config.yml.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Holds config.yml, the autoscan.db database, and activity.log. Autoscan waits until config.yml exists here.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Read-only mount of your media. Autoscan needs it for anchor files and the inotify trigger. Use /media paths in config.yml, or rewrite the paths that your triggers and targets use.
